title: CI builds the wasm crate and runs the wasm and plans tests
description:
The Rust CI job runs `cargo test --workspace --exclude apricity-web` with a step name claiming the web job covers the wasm crate. The web job only runs `npm ci`, `tsc --noEmit`, `test:flow` and `contract:check`. Nothing builds `apricity-web` for `wasm32-wasip1` or runs `web/test/wasm.test.mjs`, so the first wasm build of any change is the Amplify production deploy (`amplify.yml` → `scripts/amplify-wasm.sh`).

Also not run in CI because they need the wasm binary or are missing from `test:flow`: `web/test/data/plans.test.ts` (1068 lines), `web/test/conformance/match.test.ts`, `web/test/data/auth.test.ts`, `web/test/data/files.test.ts`.

Done when: a CI job installs wasi-sdk (`scripts/fetch-tools.sh`), builds `apricity-web` for `wasm32-wasip1`, runs `cargo test -p apricity-dsp --target wasm32-wasip1`, `node web/test/wasm.test.mjs`, and the four tests above; `test:flow` lists every test file under `web/test` (or a glob replaces the hand-maintained list).
